summary: TRM Forensics, a graph-based blockchain investigation product used by government agencies and financial institutions.
highlights: Removed quadratic hot paths in the investigation graph across two renderers (ReGraph, then KeyLines); led a 20+ PR push in which memoized index lookups took plot matching on 1,600 elements from 15.5 s to 14 ms.
Built the chat UI for Co-Case Agent (now Orion), TRM’s AI investigation assistant, launched March 2026.
Proposed and built a Radix UI + Tailwind design system; all new UI is built on it. Keyboard-navigable data tables for a government contract.
Introduced route-level code splitting (~85% smaller initial bundle), led frontend i18n with typed keys and CI checks, and built an OpenAPI-typed API client.
Shipped Triage escalation, Deconflict notifications and the T3 Financial Crime Unit flow end to end. 580+ merged PRs.

Led a project that cut the running cost of an A/B-testing service by about 90%: it ran its full code path to serve static HTML files, so I added a caching layer and a configuration system that splits traffic between variants (for example 70/30).
Improved frontend load time by about 30%.
Built a stock-market education video platform and a standalone ETF page.
ThoughtSpot: migrated the core charting and table area from a legacy Angular app to React micro-frontends with GraphQL and Apollo Client.
Open Financial: refactored the frontend onto Next.js and React Query.
